title: Illuminate
subtitle: Campus Ideation & Bootcamp
description: Illuminate was a 48-hour intensive ideation bootcamp designed to help polytechnic students build viable business models, refine customer validation, and prepare for the Eureka! national competition. Participants worked in cross-disciplinary teams with continuous mentor support and ended the sprint with investor-ready one-pagers.
highlights: Three Teams Advanced to Eureka! Regionals
